note: FAOSTAT reports Belgium-Luxembourg (15, BLX-1850-1999) through 1999 and Belgium (255) and Luxembourg (256) from 2000; the support carries only the two members, so 15's cells are their union.
Viet Nam (237) is F237-1954-1975, the combined reporting of North and South Vietnam; the support carries only the two members, so 237's cells are their union.
Yemen (249) is F249-1918-1990; in 1961 the support carries its two predecessors, the Mutawakkilite Kingdom and Aden, so 249's cells are their union.

From 1962 the support carries no complete Yemeni predecessor (MKY-1918-1962 has ended, ADE-1839-1967 ends in 1967, and North and South Yemen have no geometry), so 249 is placed on the cells of modern Yemen.
FAOSTAT reports the Estonian SSR inside the USSR (228) and Estonia (63) only from 1992.
FAOSTAT reports the Latvian SSR inside the USSR (228) and Latvia (119) only from 1992.
FAOSTAT reports the Lithuanian SSR inside the USSR (228) and Lithuania (126) only from 1992.
FAOSTAT reports the Azerbaijan SSR inside the USSR (228); the polity maps to no reporting area.
FAOSTAT reports the USSR (228) in 1991 and its successors only from 1992, while the support switches to the successors in 1991.
FAOSTAT reports the Yugoslav SFR (248) in 1991 and North Macedonia (154) only from 1992, while the support carries North Macedonia from 1991.

Spain (203) reports the Canary Islands, which have no reporting area of their own: FAOSTAT's country area for Spain, 50,599 kha, is the whole national territory with the islands. The end year 2026 reaches the open period's inclusive 2025 (whep#1008).
Spain (203) reports Ceuta and Melilla, which have no reporting area of their own; see ICN-1800-2025 (whep#1008).

FAOSTAT's Serbia (272) covers Kosovo, which has no reporting area: its country area is 8,836 kha in 2006-2015, Serbia's 77,474 km2 plus Kosovo's 10,887 km2, and 8,499 kha in 2022, still above Serbia's own (whep#1008).
FAOSTAT reports Guam as 88, which the crosswalk maps to GUM-1898-1950 only and which has no regions.csv row, so it lives in the Rest of World bucket (999) like its predecessor (whep#1008).

No FAOSTAT area reports Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba after the Netherlands Antilles (151) ended in 2010, and the Netherlands (150) excludes them; they join their sibling Curacao (279) in the Rest of World bucket (999) (whep#1008).
